craft_notes: Sthāyin: Seal of completion (samādhi). Comma→dash (gem held, wright released). Colophon seals. Rejected: 'made' flat for 'wrought' — wrought is older; kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: This laud-gem, gravid with granted longings, luck's lodging of love —
for Śambhu wrought Nārāyaṇa the Preceptor.
l4.sanskrit_cite: stavacintāmaṇiṃ bhūrimanorathaphalapradam bhaktilakṣmyālayaṃ śambho bhaṭṭanārāyaṇo vyadhāt

reads_against.argmap: The wish-jewel of praise, giving rich fruits of wishes. → Bhaṭṭanārāyaṇa made this devotion-jewel for Śambhu.
c1_essence: Praise-gem heavy with longings wrought by Nārāyaṇa for Śambhu.
reads_against.l2: This praise-gem, heavy with granted longings, Lakṣmī's lodging of love — for Śambhu wrought Bhaṭṭa Nārāyaṇa.
l3: This laud-gem, gravid with granted longings, love's fortune-house —
for Śambhu wrought Nārāyaṇa the Preceptor.
reads_against.t1: The wish-jewel of praise, giving rich fruits of wishes, abode of devotion's fortune — O Śambhu — Bhaṭṭanārāyaṇa made.
